correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed r=P^2/4+P'/2-Q as -2(z^2+1)^2/(9z^2(z^2-1)^2) and re-ran kovacic_verdict.py (exit 0). Pole orders exactly 2 at 0,1,-1,infty with b=-2/9 and sqrt(1+4b)=1/3 verified by limits. Case 1 max d=-1/3<0 over all 16 tuples; Case 2 E={2} everywhere with unique d=-2<0; Case 3 maxima -4/3,-2,-4<0 for n=4,6,12. Halting at negative degrees is correct Kovacic procedure, yielding no Liouvillian solution and Galois group SL(2,C), hence no dihedral symmetric-square solution.
